name: Mimasaka Hinata
source: Protagonist's classmate and best friend. Completely different from the honor student Akari, she advocates freedom and is graceful. Likes maids, and is even operating a maid cafe. When faced with something interesting she becomes very energetic, but when its something she isn't interested in, her reaction can be slow. When she heard about the protagonist getting married, she too wanted to marry him. All in said, she is just an ordinary relaxed otaku girl.
